name: five_secrets
summary: An analytical video essay blending personal talking-head delivery with extensive interview excerpts, timeline breakdowns, and cinematic case studies. Its distinctiveness comes from kinetic pacing, precise graphic callouts, chapter trackers, and punchy textual emphasis.

captions.notes: Select key phrases pop onto screen in giant uppercase bold text for comedic or dramatic punch rather than continuous subtitles.

headline.notes: Large bold title cards introduce major themes, paired with a persistent chapter progress bar along the lower third.

callouts.notes: Vibrant color-coded pills label structural concepts like character action, accompanied by animated bounding boxes and crosshairs.

transitions.notes: Rapid cuts with frequent punch-ins on the host, interspersed with audio leading into illustrative B-roll.

rules: Punch in on the speaker during tonal shifts or sarcastic remarks
Display a persistent lower-third chapter bar to track narrative structure
Emphasize punchlines with large, centered, uppercase text pop-ins
Illustrate editing concepts with timeline recordings and color-coded labels
Cut away to documentary and podcast footage every 3 to 5 seconds
Use eye-tracing crosshair graphics when explaining visual composition
Support sponsor integrations with authentic on-screen screen-recordings and live demos
Smooth out visual jumps with overlapping J-cuts and L-cuts on dialogue
Anchor narrative arguments with relevant visual evidence or B-roll every 3 to 5 seconds
Use punch zooms on the speaker during key conversational pivots
Highlight editorial terms using high-contrast pill labels and framing brackets
Maintain chapter progress via a minimal bottom navigation bar
avoid: Full-time karaoke-style subtitles covering the whole video
Static wide talking-head shots lasting more than 6 seconds
Decorative 3D transitions or cheesy page turns
Unmotivated B-roll that does not directly support the point being made
Aggressive flashing effects or chaotic whip pans
Unmotivated B-roll without topical narrative connection
Covering speaker face completely with oversized stickers
